The following events took place in '''2 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*The [[Ssi-ruuvi invasions]] began when the [[Ssi-ruuvi Imperium]] [[Battle of G'rho|invaded]] the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[G'rho]], with arrangements by [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].<ref name="TABSB" />
*[[Galen Marek]] [[Battle on Death Star I|sacrificed]] himself in his duel with Darth Sidious aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]].<ref name="TFUv" /><ref name="TFUn" />
*[[Corellian System Meetings]].<ref name="TEGtW-161">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
*The [[Corellian Treaty]] was signed, [[Corellian System Meetings|forming]] the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="TFUv" /><ref name="TFUn" />
*The [[Declaration of Rebellion/Legends|Declaration of Rebellion]] began the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="TFUn" />
*The remnants of [[Kota's Militia]], along with most of the surviving [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist holdouts]] were absorbed into the Rebel Alliance.<ref name="TFUv" />
*[[Dantooine base/Legends|Sanctuary Base]] was established on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] as the first command center of the Rebel Alliance.
*[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] traveled to the planet of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] the [[Death/Legends|deceased]] [[Galen Marek]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II novelization">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II'' novelization]]</ref>
*Emperor Palpatine created the position of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]].
*Large [[phrikite]] deposits were located on [[Gromas 16]].
*The [[Cult of Varn]] was developed on [[Kamar/Legends|Kamar]].<ref name="Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref>
*[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] won the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] from [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] during a [[Cloud City Sabacc Tournament|sabacc tournament]] on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]].<ref name="TEGtW-161" />
*[[Hart-and-Parn Gorra-Fiolla]], Solo, [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], and [[Odumin]] disrupted the [[Bonadan/Legends|Bonadan]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] trade.
*[[Greedo/Legends|Greedo]] befriended [[Anky Fremp]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].
*Solo and Chewbacca attempted a [[clotheslegging]] scheme in the [[Cron Drift/Legends|Cron Drift]].
*[[Dev Sibwarra]] was captured by the [[Ssi-ruu]]k.<ref name="TABSB" />
*Construction on the [[Skyhook (Kashyyyk)|Kashyyyk Skyhook]] began.<ref name="TFUn" /><ref name="TFUv" />
*[[Corellian Security Force]] inspector [[Hal Horn]] arrests [[Booster Terrik]] on a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] charge.<ref name="NEGC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref>
*Newly-appointed as [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]], [[Kentor Sarne]] requests the reassignment of the [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] [[FarStar|''Renegade'']] from reserve duty to his forces.<ref name="DSC">''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]''</ref>
